_meta.description: Structured v2.0 reference-tag index for Cars24 Maker Agent. Every reference asset is tagged by what it is allowed to teach: layout, typography, logo context, pattern texture, photo style, illustration style, icon style, palette, shape, USP stamp, or rules-only guidance.
_meta.usage: Query this index at generation time before Stage 7 to select best-fit references per layer. Every selected reference must be presented with role, attachability, copy-from, ignore-from, and reason. Do not learn from 4_exports/ as canonical reference input.
_meta.note: Max 3 references per Higgsfield call. Swatch + logo often take 2 slots; use the third for the highest-scoring style-defining ref. Overflow refs get baked into prompt text via their prompt_fallback field.
_meta.asset_recheck: 2026-06-19: 102 indexed media assets, 102 on-disk canonical media assets, 0 missing indexed assets, 0 unindexed media assets.
excluded_sources: output audits unless explicitly promoted into master-rules.md
guiding_principles: References describe what the agent may copy, not just what the image contains.
Exports are output history and must not become canonical reference-learning input.
DT/LT theme cards with marble/statue subjects are layout references only.
Photo heroes must use real humans, real customers, real Cars24 staff, real cars, real hubs, or real service moments.

Logo references are generation-time assets; final logo fidelity comes from faithfully rendering the attached/shared visible logo reference inside the generated composite. Do not use local logo post-processing.
Rules-only pages must never be attached to image generation.
